description: §42.2.3 — the soft-deprecated `given name :>` present-case arm of a `match` over a `string | not` value surfaces W-GIVEN-PRESENCE-DEPRECATED (Warning; exactly 1) and is accepted (no E- code: the `not` arm plus the `given` arm are exhaustive). CODES HALF ONLY: the run-time half is not asserted here, because impl#1 drops the body of a `given` match arm (g-impl1-given-match-arm-body-dropped-s462) — the §63.5 identity with `else :>` does not hold on impl#1 today. The legacy spelling is the PURPOSE of this case; it is not migrated.
rationale: §42.2.3 (S462) — the `given x :>` match arm is SOFT-DEPRECATED (canonical: `else :>` after the `not :>` arm) and surfaces W-GIVEN-PRESENCE-DEPRECATED; §63.5 — the W-code is a conformance-required code during the window. Provenance: ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S462 "a, go".
